summary: Faraday Future Intelligent Electric filed a Form 8-K on September 21, 2026 reporting under Item 8.01 that it issued a press release on September 19, 2026 announcing new products at its annual 919 event. The company launched four Industry Productivity Solutions across K-12 Education, Research, Security and Inspection, plus nine new EAI device configurations spanning five models, all now available for sale. FF Master Mini starts at $9,990; robotics products reached roughly 30% average contribution margin based on Q2 results. CFO Koti Meka signed. This is a product-launch disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations apply.
